I see the same "Aborted" dialog. The APK you have installed is **not** the new v1.10.1 — the error message and timeout still match the old direct-Supabase path. The backend login code is in the bundle, but the app on your device is likely an older build, or the APK was not downloaded/installed.

First, confirm the installed APK version:

1. On your Android device, open **Settings → Apps → IVX Holdings** (or whatever the app name shows).
2. Look for the version — it should say **1.10.1**. If it says 1.10.0 or 1.9.x, the old APK is still installed.

The new APK is here: **https://gofile.io/d/gyeWqi** (v1.10.1, versionCode 99, md5: `ab1966903d4f0ee2fa79bcebd065503f`).

Download it directly on your phone and install it. Then sign in again and time it.

If the new APK still shows "Aborted" after 5 seconds, I need the exact runtime logs from the app. Until then, the fix is deployed but the device is not running it.

**Verdict remains: NOT END-TO-END COMPLETE — pending device install/verify.**
